question: How the original colours the map in the simplified terrain (13), naval (19) and region (3) modes, what else each shows, and each one's tooltip part.

addresses.name: MapMode_Naval_Colour
addresses.comment: **The naval map mode's colours** (mode 19), MapMode_Air_Colour's twin; the province graphics entries (graphics owner +0x1DC4) on the stack, `ret 4`. (1) Every entry from 1: ground and stripes 0x80808080 (grey, alpha 0x80). (2) For each CDiplomacyStatus of the player (CCurrentGameState +0xC30/+0xC34) towards every country (CCountry +0xE28, in country order) whose undeclared war (+0x24) is set and is not the same war as the last one met: every province id of the war's region provinces (CUndeclaredWar +0x38..+0x3C) gets ground and stripes 0x80FFD240 (orange), unconditionally. (3) For each unit of the map's country (CMap +0x2A88/+0x2A8C; CCountry +0xBAC, every level) with an order: its save token (order slot 16) through OrderTypeToMissionIndex - 6 `patrol`: ground 0x8040FF40 (green) and the stripes too where still grey; 10 `convoy_raid`: stripes 0x80FF4040 (red) and the ground too where still grey; both on the order's province (COrder +0xC, no null test) and on each of its neighbours (CProvinceTemplate +0x90 edges, +4 the id) that is water (template +0x22 clear) and not WaterIsClosed to the player. 9 `convoy_escort`: the convoy is looked up afresh by its id (+0x4C/+0x50, stored back in +0x48); where it, the beat's two ends (+0x74, +0x78) and its path (CConvoy +0xB0) exist, the path is walked from its head and every province from the first end through the last end is coloured green as patrol (the walk stops at the last end whether or not the first was met). Other orders colour nothing. Seven callers: MapMode_Naval_Set; CPatrolOrder::Start, CConvoyRaid::Start, CConvoyEscortOrder::Start and the three destructors, each only in mode 19 and for a unit of the player's (CUnit +0x128 against CCurrentGameState +0xC34), each followed by Map_RefreshColourTextures(0). Not called by CInGameIdler_RefreshMap or the daily update. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-mapmodesrest.md, section 3.
addresses.evidence: Read whole off the listing 0x8674E0-0x86789B (one ret 4; seven callers by findRefs). Constants are the immediates stored. Token-to-index: OrderTypeToMissionIndex is the recorded table (FINDINGS-unitpaneltooltips.md 10: patrol 6, convoy_escort 9, convoy_raid 10). Wrong if order slot 16 is not the save token (CConvoyEscortOrder::GetTypeId is that slot in the record).

addresses.name: MapMode_Region_Colour
addresses.comment: **The region map mode's colours** (mode 3); the province graphics entries on the stack, `ret 4`; one caller, MapMode_Region_Set. For every entry from 1, with P the map's country (CMap +0x2A8C): brightness = 1.0 where P's intel of the province (+0x370, counted at +0x374) is 2 or more, else 0.5, and 0 where the template's simulated byte (+0x13D) is clear. The base colour is grey (b x 0.5, b x 0.5, b x 0.5, 1) - packed 0xFF7F7F7F, 0xFF3F3F3F or 0xFF000000. Then, **with the in-game screen's continent painting off** (CInGameIdler +0x8, the `cpaint` console command): where the province is in a region (CMapProvince +0x360 above 0), the colour of the first region of its list (+0x358) through RegionOrContinent_GetColour and CombineColourBrightness; **with it on**: where it has a continent (+0x368), the continent's colour so. The packed result goes to both the ground and the stripes, so there are no stripes. A region's colour is set by CMap_AssignRegionAndContinentColours from interface/colors.txt. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-mapmodesrest.md, section 2.
addresses.evidence: Read whole off the listing 0x865930-0x865B63. 0x15AB304 = 0.5f, 0x171DBAC = 1.0f, 0x160A308 = 0.5 (double), read from the image. Wrong if the singleton at 0x1A89790 is not CCurrentGameState (it is built with vftable 0x15CF674 and in_game at +0xDA4, and +0xBE8 is the record's in_game_screen).

addresses.name: MapMode_SimplifiedTerrain_ColourLoop
addresses.comment: **The simplified terrain map mode's colours** (mode 13); the province graphics entries in EDI, bare `ret`, nothing on the stack; one caller, MapMode_SimplifiedTerrain_Driver (the setter). For every entry from 1: brightness = 1.0 where the map's country's (CMap +0x2A8C) intel of the province is 2 or more, else 0.5, and 0 where the template's simulated byte (+0x13D) is clear; colour = CombineColourBrightness(TerrainColour(the template's CTerrain, +0xC), brightness) - the terrain's own `color` of map/terrain.txt's categories, as read by CColor::Load - packed to both the ground and the stripes. Sea provinces are coloured too (ocean's 0 0 255) and never shown, because the mode's map style 8 is not one of the three (16, 18, 19) that draw the water from province colours. Not recoloured by CInGameIdler_RefreshMap. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-mapmodesrest.md, section 1.
addresses.evidence: Read whole, 0x865B70-0x865C36; EDI is set by the setter (lea edi,[eax+0x1dc4] at 0x666E87) and read at 0x865B76 before any write. checkSignatures should see a bare ret with no stack parameters.

addresses.name: TerrainColour
addresses.comment: **A copy of a terrain's colour**: *out = the CColor at CTerrain +0xC (token +0x10, r g b a +0x14..+0x20, opaque byte +0x24), the vftable written fresh; returns out, bare `ret`. CTerrain::LoadKey reads `color` (token 0x55) into that CColor through its slot 3 (CColor::Load: each of r, g, b divided by 255 where above 1.0). One caller, MapMode_SimplifiedTerrain_ColourLoop. In no virtual table. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-mapmodesrest.md, section 1.
addresses.evidence: Ten instructions read whole; the LoadKey arm at 0x4ADA59 -> 0x4ADB2B (lea ecx,[this+0xC]; call [vft+0xC]); CTerrain::CTerrain writes the CColor vftable at +0xC (0x4AD820). vtable.py --holding: in no table.

addresses.name: CombineColourBrightness
addresses.no_signature: the colour in ECX, the out CColor in EAX and the brightness as a float in XMM1; returns out in EAX, bare ret - XMM1 cannot be written as a parameter
addresses.comment: **A colour times a brightness**: out.r/g/b = min(float(double(colour.c) x double(b)), 1.0) each, out.a = colour.a unchanged, out's opaque byte = all four above 0.999; the vftable and token 0x18D written fresh. Called by the simplified terrain and region colourings (and others not read here). See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-mapmodesrest.md, section 1.
addresses.evidence: Read whole 0x643750-0x643817; 0x171DBAC = 1.0f the clamp, 0x160A2D8 = 0.999 the opaque test.

addresses.name: RegionOrContinent_GetColour
addresses.comment: *out = the CColor at +0x50 of the object in ECX (token +0x54, r g b a +0x58..+0x64, opaque +0x68); returns out, bare `ret`. Called with a CRegion and with a CContinent - both carry their colour at +0x50 - so the body is named for neither (a fold of two getters, inferred). Eight callers: the region colouring (twice), two other mode colourings at rva 0x464C40 and 0x465290 (not read here) and two at VA 0x64DC2B and 0x64E0D1, in a function not identified that indexes CMap's regions. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-mapmodesrest.md, section 2.
addresses.evidence: Read whole (0x486EB0-0x486ED6). The region colouring calls it with the first region of a province (0x865B14) and with its continent (0x865AF4). In no virtual table (vtable.py --holding).

addresses.name: CMap_AssignRegionAndContinentColours
addresses.comment: **Where regions and continents get their colours.** Reads `interface/colors.txt` - the interface slot of g_CDirectorySettings (+0xF0, override +0x294, mode +0x54: 1 the mod's alone, 2 the mod's where it exists) - and keeps, in file order, a list of every `color = { r g b }` (token 0x55, CColor::Load; any other token is passed over). Then over CMap's regions (+0x2A40, region.txt's order): a region with no province is passed over and takes no colour; otherwise it takes the list's next colour (copied into CRegion +0x54..+0x68); **when the list is used up, the region met then takes nothing and keeps its constructor's white, and the list starts again from its first colour with the next region**. Then the same over the continents (+0x2A30), from the list's first colour again, with no test for an empty one. One caller, CGameState_StartupResetAndLoadGameplaySettings (0x67B5FF), with g_CMap: once a process, at startup. `ret 4`. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-mapmodesrest.md, section 2.
addresses.evidence: Extent 0x68A6E0-0x68AC84 by int3 runs (functionStart answers 0x68AA19, trap 2's second cause). The '/colors.txt' literal is pushed three times; token 0x55 is 'color' in saveTokens.json. The wrap: 'cmp edi,ebx; je 0x68AB22' re-enters at 'mov edi,[ebp-0x44]' (the head) after ecx was already advanced. Wrong if +0x2A30 is not the continent vector (CMap::AssignContinents walks it).

addresses.name: UpdateNavalMapIcons
addresses.comment: **What the naval map mode (19) shows**, UpdateAirMapIcons' twin. Four **flags** a province (bytes, zeroed, only ever set to 1), out of the list of finished battles (CCurrentGameState +0xB7C, the CCombatHistory inside the combat manager at +0xB5C): for each entry of kind 2 (naval) at its province (+0x24), with P the player (CCurrentGameState +0xC30/+0xC34): ours-attacking = the attacker is P, or the attacker is a country other than id 0 and REB and P IsSameSide with it or is co_belligerent with it (+0x58 of P's status) without IsEnemyTag, or P IsEnemyTag the defender; ours-defending = the defender is P, or CanOperateIn(P, defender). A convoy raid's battle (+0x20 set): byte 0 where still clear and ours-attacking; else (or where byte 0 was already set) byte 1 where still clear and ours-defending. Any other naval battle: byte 3 so, else byte 2 so. Then for every province from 1: ShowConvoyRaidedIcon(byte 1, our convoys raided), ShowConvoySunkIcon(byte 0, convoys we sank), ShowRaiderDefendedIcon(byte 2, we were attacked), ShowRaiderAttackedIcon(byte 3, we attacked); and ShowLargeNavalBaseIcon with the naval base's built level (CMapProvince +0x300 -> +0x20, / 1000) where P's intel of the province is 2 or more, else 1 where it has a naval base at all (no simulated test). Callers: MapMode_Naval_Set, MapMode_SwitchIcons (19) and CInGameIdler::DailyUpdate in mode 19. `ret 4`. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-mapmodesrest.md, section 3; reversing/findings/FINDINGS-billboardfx.md, section 3.
addresses.evidence: Fill loop read whole, 0x86A784-0x86A953; the four Show calls and the naval base loop 0x86A959-0x86AA4E. The bytes are only ever written 1 (mov byte [..],1). Callers by findRefs: 0x661D06 (DailyUpdate), 0x66822F, 0x678A6F. Wrong if +0xB7C is not the history's first entry - the constructor writes CCombatHistory's vftable at +0xB74 (0x67D2B2) and its first/last at +0xB7C/+0xB80.

addresses.name: HideNavalMapIcons
addresses.comment: Takes the naval map mode's pictures down: for every province graphics entry from 1, each of the four naval icons (+0x6C, +0x70, +0x74, +0x78) and the large naval base (+0x80) that exists is hidden (slot 14), removed from the graphics owner's layer +0x14D4 (0xA6FBC0) and the pointer cleared. `ret 4`. HideAirMapIcons' twin; 25 callers - every map-mode setter but the naval one, MapMode_SwitchIcons, CInGameIdler::Enter, CFrontEnd::Enter and others. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-mapmodesrest.md, section 3.
addresses.evidence: Read whole 0x86AA70-0x86ABF1. The five offsets agree with the Show* entries' records (+0x6C raided, +0x70 sunk, +0x74 defended, +0x78 attacked, +0x80 naval base).

addresses.name: CPatrolOrder::~CPatrolOrder
addresses.comment: **CPatrolOrder's destructor body** (`this` on the stack, `ret 4`; called only by its scalar deleting destructor). Writes the class's vftable (VA 0x15C6F14), then, where the in-game screen's map mode is 19 and the order's unit (+0x8) is the player's (CUnit +0x128 against CCurrentGameState +0xC34), MapMode_Naval_Colour(graphics owner +0x1DC4) and Map_RefreshColourTextures(0) - **at the top, before the order is taken apart**. Whether the unit still holds the dying order then, and so whether its provinces stay coloured, was not read. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-mapmodesrest.md, section 3.

addresses.name: ConsoleCmd_Paint
addresses.comment: **The console command `paint`** (its row in the command table at VA 0x170B... carries the name and a help text 'Switch to ... painting mode.'). With any argument: 'Invalid arguments count'. Otherwise flips the in-game screen's byte CInGameIdler +0x5 (through CCurrentGameState +0xBE8) and answers 'Now painting the map, use tag XXX to change what to paint.' when it is now set, 'Painting disabled' when clear. Returns the result, bare `ret`. A map editor left in the release; nothing in the three map modes read here tests this byte. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-mapmodesrest.md, section 2.
addresses.evidence: Read off the listing; the function pointer sits in .data beside its help string and the name string (paint); bare ret.

addresses.name: CRegion::GetLocalisedName

Where the localised name the constructor cached at +0x34 equals the key (+0x18) - the key has no localisation - and the region has provinces: REGION_NAME ('$NAME$ Region') with NAME = the name of its first province (CMap +0x2200 by the first id, slot 7 of the province's second base). Otherwise a copy of +0x34. `ret 4`. Used by the region mode's tooltip. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-mapmodesrest.md, section 2.

addresses.name: String_CapitaliseFirst
addresses.comment: Upper-cases the first character of the string in EAX in place, through the CRT's toupper over the one-character range [begin, begin + 1) (0xA5CD20); bare `ret`. One caller, the region mode's tooltip, on a continent's name. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-mapmodesrest.md, section 2.
addresses.evidence: Read whole, and its helper 0xA5CD20 (a transform loop calling 0xB99C65 per byte).

addresses.name: ProvinceTooltip_Mode3
addresses.comment: **The region map mode's part of the province tooltip** (jump-table entry 3). Province register 8 bytes in. With continent painting off (CInGameIdler +0x8 clear): for each region of the province's list, in order, "\n - " + CRegion::GetLocalisedName, and "*" after it where the region is used for peace (+0x6C). Then, whatever the painting, where the province has a continent: "\n" + its localised name with the first letter upper-cased (String_CapitaliseFirst). See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-mapmodesrest.md, section 4.
addresses.evidence: Read off the listing 0x49924F-0x4993D6; the strings at 0x15B8B68 ('\n - '), 0x15BE4C4 ('*'), 0x15B57D0 ('\n') dumped.

addresses.name: ProvinceTooltip_Mode19
addresses.comment: **The naval map mode's part of the province tooltip** (jump-table entry 19). For each entry of the list of finished battles (CCurrentGameState +0xB7C) of kind 2 at this province, with P the player: the attacker not id 0 and P or CanOperateIn(P, it) - ours attacking; else the defender not id 0 and P or CanOperateIn(P, it) - ours defending; else IsEnemyTag(P, defender) - ours attacking; else not counted. A convoy raid's battle (+0x20) counts as a raid (attacking) or a convoy sunk (defending); any other as raider attacked or raider defended. Then, each where above 0 and in this order, "\n" + NAVAL_TOOLTIP_RAIDS, NAVAL_TOOLTIP_CONVOYS_SUNK, NAVAL_TOOLTIP_RAIDER_ATTACKED, NAVAL_TOOLTIP_RAIDER_DEFENDED with NUM the count. No term for owning or controlling the province (the air part has one). See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-mapmodesrest.md, section 4.
addresses.evidence: Read off the listing 0x49C6AC-0x49CBAE; the four keys are the literals loaded; the texts are TFH's localisation.

addresses.name: MapMode_Region_Set
addresses.comment: **The region map mode's setter** (mode 3, button `mapmode_7`, bound through the glue at CInGameIdler +0xE78). Unless the mode is already 3, the `click` sound where it is not already playing (the sound's slot 25, then slot 9); the air icons and circles down when leaving 18 (HideAirMapIcons, ClearAirBaseCircles), the naval icons down (HideNavalMapIcons) when leaving 19; the idler's +0xD34 and CMap +0x2A90 = 3; **MapMode_ShowButton(7)**; the settings' layer mask +0xF0 = 0xFFBA, map style +0xF4 = 8 and +0xE7 = 0; the graphics owner's +0x60F8 = 0; HideProvinceObjects98; MapMode_Region_Colour(graphics owner +0x1DC4); Map_RefreshColourTextures(0); the graphics owner's +0x60DC = 1. Bare `ret`. Its tooltip key is `MAPMODE_7G` ('Region Mapmode'), not MAPMODE_7. Also DoTutorialAction's `mapmode region` and the air orders window's destructor for a saved 3. **The only place the region colours are made**: CInGameIdler_RefreshMap has no arm for mode 3. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-minimap.md, section 5, and reversing/findings/FINDINGS-mapmodesrest.md, section 2.
addresses.evidence: The colouring's address VA 0x865930 is the call at 0x666C8C; only the phrase '(VA 0x865930, not read)' and the naval icons' name change.
